topic: GTA 6 New Zealand trick: play hours early?

topic_score.why: Many players would love to play early, but the trick is only practical on Xbox and nobody has confirmed it works for GTA 6.

title: Can you play GTA 6 EARLY on Xbox?
description: New Zealand reportedly unlocks first, at 4:30 PM IST on November 18, and on Xbox you can reportedly change your console location to New Zealand in Settings. Nobody has confirmed that this works for GTA 6, and Microsoft reportedly limits Xbox region changes to once every 3 months, while Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19.
